description: King Ateas, who ruled a powerful Scythian realm in the 4th century BC, appears to have strengthened royal authority by consolidating previously independent tribal groups under a more centralized leadership. His reign was marked by expansion, tighter control over tribute and warfare, and closer economic contact with Greek settlements along the Black Sea, which likely encouraged greater social stratification and the growth of a more powerful warrior aristocracy. Although the evidence does not support a detailed program of formal “social reforms,” Ateas seems to have helped transform Scythian society toward a more unified and hierarchical kingdom centered on the authority of the king.
requirementsTooltip: Unlocked in Town Phase after choosing the hero Ateas.
